SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'QTHDDOWN' AND TARGET IN ( 'KRHWAS0031' , 'KRKRHW0001', 'KRHWAS0045' ) AND KEY_10 IN (' ','N') GROUP BY DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.QUOTATION_NO AS INQ_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ AS INQ_SEQ, A.REVISION AS REVISION, '02' AS INQ_STATUS, A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS RECEIVE_PRC, NVL(A.DESCRIPTION,' ') AS RETURN_ITEM_NM, NVL(A.SPECIFICATION,' ') AS RETURN_SPEC, NVL(A.UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS RETURN_UNIT, NVL(A.MAKER_NAME,' ') AS RETURN_MAKER, NVL(C.LEAD_TIME,' ') AS DLV_CNT FROM KEPRQDT A, ICOMTRXL B, KEPQTDT C WHERE 1=1 AND B.TARGET = A.BUYER AND B.KEY_1 = A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.KEY_2 = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO = C.QUOTATION_NO AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ= C.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.REVISION = C.REVISION AND C.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND C.STATUS = 'C' AND B.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND B.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND B.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND B.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND B.KEY_10 IN (' ','N') ORDER BY A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','N')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'E', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','N')
